You can further customize alerts for unfollowed threads, tags, and channel or team mentions, as well as control banner notifications for the chan (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Outlook: Choose to Show Unread or Total Count for Each Folder
item.description: <p>You can now pick whether each folder in your folder pane shows the unread count or the total item count. Until now, Outlook only displayed unread counts, but sometimes you need to see how many items are in a folder overall. Just right-click any folder and choose whether to show the total or unrea (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Outlook: User-initiated Copilot insights in classic Outlook
item.description: <p>Users can manually select text and ask Copilot to help provide relevant information.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Outlook

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Protect sensitive data over FTP and SFTP with Endpoint DLP
item.description: <p>Endpoint DLP support for FTP and SFTP enables organizations to monitor and protect sensitive data transferred from managed endpoints using FTP and SFTP, helping prevent unauthorized data exfiltration while maintaining visibility and control.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Malicious URL Protection for Teams Chat and Channels for Gov clouds
item.description: <p>Microsoft Teams can now detect and warn users on malicious URLs sent in Teams chat and channels in Gov clouds, increasing protection against malware attacks for Gov clouds customers.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs
item.description: <p>Copilot Chat can now better match search results from Scanned PDFs on Copilot users' files they are working on — content that was previously difficult to search and find.</p> <p>This feature will work for new/updated user's working files on a go-forward basis.</p> (GA: October CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements
item.description: <p>Improving permission checks when users access the Microsoft Purview portal. Enhanced audit logs will provide clearer visibility into role and scoped-role access decisions, helping administrators troubleshoot access issues and monitor authorization outcomes.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Purview

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: <p>Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Local PTZ for Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows
item.description: <p>Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows will provide native Pan-Tilt-Zoom (PTZ) controls for connected cameras that support this capability, whether the camera moves a physical lens or adjusts the image digitally. Controls are available when Teams Rooms can confirm the camera isn't independently framing (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage: New left navigation controls — collapse, resize, increased favorites cap, and reorder favorites capabilities
item.description: <p>We're introducing a set of left-navigation improvements in Viva Engage on the web that give people more control over their navigation pane. These are additive, user-driven changes — users can collapse the left nav, resize its width, favorite up to 50 communities, and drag to reorder their favorit (GA: August CY2026) — Microsoft Viva

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Ask Copilot about highlighted response content
item.description: <p>Highlight a sentence, paragraph, or table from the response and ask Copilot to work only on that selection. Get focused explanations, concise summaries, quick translations, or next steps for the exact passage you’re reviewing—no more over broad answers. Your selection is previewed in the prompt s (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: <p>Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Teams Admin Center - Single pane for monitoring & troubleshooting for meetings and calls across the organisation
item.description: <p>Administrators can monitor meeting and call health across the organization, uncover recurring patterns, and proactively troubleshoot issues impacting users in both active and completed meetings and calls.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: <p>Users can now temporarily pause all notifications to minimize interruptions and stay focused on important work, meetings, or other priorities, without changing their existing notification settings.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: OneNote: Suggested Artifact Creation in Copilot Notebooks
item.description: <p>Copilot Notebooks in OneNote now suggests artifacts to create, such as Word documents, Excel workbooks, and PowerPoint presentations, based on Microsoft 365 knowledge and the content in your notebook. Select the suggestion and Copilot will generate the artifact.</p> (GA: August CY2026) — OneNote, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)

item.title: Microsoft Teams: Clearer text highlighting in dark mode and high contrast mode
item.description: <p>We've improved how highlighted text looks when composing messages in dark mode and high contrast mode, giving you a more consistent editing experience.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Teams

item.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): New Rich Answer Cards
item.description: <p>Surface new model-driven, dynamically placed Answer Cards across top 7 segments: weather, sports, finance, images, video, places and news for Entra &amp; MSA users across all surfaces.</p> (GA: September CY2026) — Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)
